similar_in_english: Burning the midnight oil (in a risky context)
example_sentences_in_bangla: আজ রাতবিরাত, বাইরে যাওয়া উচিত নয়।
গ্রামে রাতবিরাতে একা ঘুরতে ভয় লাগে।
example_sentences_in_english: Tonight is a night of danger; don't go out.
In the village, wandering alone at the dead of night feels scary.
note: This idiom emphasizes traditional caution against nighttime risks in Bengali folklore.
